Independent EHR review. 8.9/10 rating. Founded 2008 by physicians. Highlighted form management as standout feature, flexible reporting, affordable pricing (<$600/mo for some), 40 engineers, 24/7 emergency support. Learning curve noted as weakness.

226 reviews, 4.83/5 stars. Users praise customization, ease of use, customer support, and time savings on progress notes. Platform consolidates portal, notes, scheduling, billing. Some report occasional logout issues.

Detailed feature listing. Patient records, scheduling, billing with chargemaster, patient portal, reporting (clinical/operational/financial), document management, mobile apps. Multi-location support, program-specific workflows. Serves primary care, pediatrics, behavioral health, substance abuse.
Software Advice profile. Pricing starts at $800/month. Confirmed behavioral health EHR with billing, scheduling, patient portal, EPCS. Could not access full page (403).

FindEMR profile. Targets small to mid-sized behavioral health practices. Appointment management, patient intake, billing to any clearinghouse, patient portal, reporting, document management, controlled substance ordering. Serves mental health, substance abuse, autism, case management, inpatient/outpatient.

EMRSystems profile. Customizable notes with voice dictation, e-Rx, lab integration, CMS 1500 and UB-04 billing, CRM tools, real-time dashboard, ad-hoc reporting. Covers inpatient/outpatient mental health, substance abuse, case management, autism, social work.

EHR In Practice profile. 65 programmers, 5000+ features, 180-day money-back guarantee. Market leading chargemaster. Serves behavioral health, IDD, eating disorders, homeless shelters, correctional health, community health centers, speech therapy. Practice sizes 11-50+ physicians. Cloud-based, HIPAA/ICD-10/CPT/HL7 certified.
